Taxable Purchases per Supplier

The Taxable Purchases Per Supplier report provides a breakdown of tax amounts organized by supplier for your specified reporting period.

This report is essential for tax compliance, helping you track and verify the tax collected on purchases from each supplier.

What This Report Shows

For each supplier and tax code combination, the report displays three key amounts:

• Net Purchases - The purchase amounts before tax

• Tax on Purchases - The tax amounts charged by suppliers

• Total Purchases - The combined total of net purchases plus tax

Report Organization

Transactions are grouped by tax code, with suppliers listed alphabetically within each tax code group.

This organization makes it easy to see which tax codes apply to purchases from specific suppliers and helps identify tax patterns across your supplier base.

For configuration options, see: Taxable Purchases per Supplier
